items.description: The report does not quantify the excess amount or define a numeric relation for the double drain; the impact is represented as a grounded Boolean occurrence.

The report does not state a concrete authorization predicate or authorized-caller set; caller_authorized is a qualitative Boolean standing in for the missing authorization definition, to be bound at code level.
The delay/block impact is qualitative; no numeric threshold or timing bound for 'delayed or blocked' is given.
